context: v1.0 media-bin + timeline + sidebar-drag bundle landed across many commits (last: e962981 on feat/creator-flow-v1-prep). Three UI bugs remain open from owner testing — canvas still doesn't aspect-fit properly, bottom timeline shows frame-ruler numbers even when empty (confusing), and the canvas-size dropdown (Kit-γ) isn't visible in the toolbar despite being wired in source + dist. Studio process was killed before context ran out; owner will provide a fresh screenshot for next session.
plan:
Next session pickup: (1) Canvas aspect-fit — applyLetterboxFit reads this.el (panel container) bounds + subtracts padding/gap/playbackH constants. The overflow:hidden change on canvasMount in e962981 should have constrained heights but the canvas still overflows per owner screenshot. Likely the constants don't match the actual studio.ts CSS pads/gaps, OR the playbackH measurement reads zero before first paint. Add a one-shot requestAnimationFrame-deferred re-fit after loadDocument so the ResizeObserver isn't fighting a partial layout. (2) Empty-timeline ruler — TimelineView renders the frame ruler unconditionally; when doc.timeline is missing/empty the ruler still draws. Either gate the ruler on tracks.length > 0 OR show a clearer empty-state hint over it ("Drop media or + add clip to see timeline"). (3) Canvas-size dropdown invisible — source + dist both have it (verified via grep), so the issue is browser-render. Likely candidates: (a) the dropdown's parent container is outside the visible toolbar overflow, (b) Vite's module cache is serving an older studio.ts (force-restart with cache clear), (c) flex sizing collapses the dropdown to 0 width. Check via devtools first — has the user inspected the DOM around the canvasSizeSelect element? If it's in the DOM but hidden, it's CSS; if not in the DOM, it's a stale-bundle issue.</plan>
